item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E011","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt concerns legal remedies, court-fee exemptions, legal assistance, passports, and torture-investigation provisions; it does not support the claimed equal school access for migrant workers’ children."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E012","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt does support Labour Code court-fee exemptions and legal assistance for persons unable to afford it, but it is not an exact excerpt for the proposed summary’s attribution to Egypt’s reported framework and includes no explicit reference to the claimed mechanisms as summarized."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E014","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt describes domestic-worker contracts, certification, social insurance, trade unions, and a draft bill; it does not mention the National Council for Women, awareness campaigns, reporting-mechanism training, or public penalties."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E016","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
